items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: One other fellow I want to tell you about. He was doing good trumpet player too. I've been trying to rake my mind's faith. He was a butcher by trade. Johnny Lawler.

ctx.x: There was Larry and Eddie Shields, and I think one called Pat Shields. I never did know him. I only knew Harry and Larry.
One other fellow I want to tell you about. He was doing good trumpet player too. I've been trying to rake my mind's faith. He was a butcher by trade. Johnny Lawler.
